title: No way to tell a converter once that it should key on field aliases
title_original: Extract use_alias from converter by default
text_original: Based on the discussion in #596, adds a `use_alias` argument to `Converter` (similar to `forbid_extra_keys') whose value is taken as default when structuring/unstructuring without specifying the corresponding argument to the method calls.
text_rewritten: Our wire format uses the field aliases rather than the field names, and today that decision has to be restated for every single model we register a generated hook for. One missed model and half the payload silently uses the wrong keys. Other whole-converter policies (rejecting unknown keys, omitting defaults, detailed validation) can be set once on the converter; this one cannot. Please add the same kind of switch: `Converter(use_alias=...)`, defaulting to False so nothing changes for existing users, and `Converter.copy(use_alias=...)` so a copy can inherit or flip it. When it is on, both structuring and unstructuring should key on aliases for every model handled by that converter without any per-model configuration.
body: Our wire format uses the field aliases rather than the field names, and today that decision has to be restated for every single model we register a generated hook for. One missed model and half the payload silently uses the wrong keys. Other whole-converter policies (rejecting unknown keys, omitting defaults, detailed validation) can be set once on the converter; this one cannot. Please add the same kind of switch: `Converter(use_alias=...)`, defaulting to False so nothing changes for existing users, and `Converter.copy(use_alias=...)` so a copy can inherit or flip it. When it is on, both structuring and unstructuring should key on aliases for every model handled by that converter without any per-model configuration.
acceptance_hint: `Converter(use_alias=True)` makes both directions key on field aliases for every model, a plain copy of it keeps that setting, `copy(use_alias=False)` turns it off, and a default converter still keys on field names.
